responsibility: Defines the compile-time interpreter machine used by CTFE, including its extra state, memory policy, stack and step-limit enforcement, panic/assert/abort handling, const-specific restrictions on pointer operations and allocation, and checks governing access to globals during constant evaluation.
same_name_distinction: This `machine.rs` defines the specific `Machine` implementation used for compile-time function evaluation, adding CTFE state and enforcing const-eval restrictions such as no mutable-global reads or pointer-to-int support. The other `machine.rs` defines the reusable interpreter `Machine` trait and shared compile-time defaults that CTFE builds on.
